question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 3.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Some**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Some **indicate a quantity that is more than "few" but less than "many" or "a lot".
 
• Grammatically, "some" is a determiner that is used to refer to an unspecified or indefinite number or amount of people or things.
 
 
• **Example**: *Some of the students were absent from class today.*
 
 
 
• As a result, 'some' is the appropriate option to fill in the blank 3.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Few **indicate a small quantity or number.
 
• **Many **indicate a large quantity or number.
 
• '**A lot**' is an informal way of indicating a large quantity or number.
